name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: What Visuals Show About Recent Damage to U.S. Military Sites in the Middle East
changes.summary: Video footage and satellite images reveal new details about Iranian strikes on U.S. targets during the latest flare-up in fighting.

changes.title: The White House pushes healthy eating. It cut a landmark nutrition education program
changes.summary: Nutrition advocates and public health experts are mystified by the decision to eliminate SNAP-Ed, given the Trump administration's embrace of the Make America Healthy Again agenda. (Image credit: Rachel Wisniewski for NPR).

changes.title: U.S. Employers Forced to Fire Thousands of Immigrants, and a Showdown over Peptides
changes.summary: Plus, America says no thanks to salad.

changes.title: How does Make America Healthy Again hold up against scientific scrutiny?
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 23 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02024-3 Researchers share their views on the US health policy spanning topics from vaccines to nutrition.

changes.title: Trump says Saudi Arabia must normalize Israel ties before nuclear deal is approved
changes.summary: President Donald Trump said Thursday that a nuclear deal between the United States and Saudi Arabia requires the kingdom to normalize relations with Israel — a significant condition not previously mentioned as the deal was announced.

changes.title: U.S.-Saudi Deal Prompts Fears of a Global Nuclear Arms Race
changes.summary: In Europe, Asia and the Middle East, countries seek nuclear capabilities to hedge against aggressive neighbors and a receding Washington, potentially creating a more freewheeling era.

changes.title: In a first, Chinese woman wins the prestigious Fields Medal
changes.summary: Despite criticisms of a brain drain from China to the U.S., the awards come at a time when several high-profile Chinese scholars have returned home, some citing an increasingly hostile academic environment in America.

changes.title: Some House Republicans defect to again pass resolution seeking to halt military action in Iran
changes.summary: The House on Thursday narrowly passed a resolution to halt U.S. military action in Iran, sending a warning to President Donald Trump for the second time as the war has escalated and the future of the conflict is increasingly uncertain.

changes.title: Israel Welcomes Trump’s Demand for Diplomatic Ties With Saudi Arabia
changes.summary: Israeli officials greeted the possibility of normalized ties, but analysts said the U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal nonetheless remained bad for Israel. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has not yet commented on the agreement.
